notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'RAPHAEL MILLET' - index.csv names NO filer for this row, so the page face fills an empty channel label. ⚠ NAME SPELLING: the page face spells it MILLET (one t) on the cover, in the signature and in the last-name box of all four inner sheets, while the county's filename and reporting-period label spell it MILLETT (raw/2014/2014_30DayMillett_2.pdf, '30 Day Recorder - Millett'). The page face governs; this is the third clerk-name drift observed in this chunk (with Guernsey/Gurnsey) and the same class as the module's Farren/Farron and Bird/Baird cases. Page-face office 'RECORDER', agreeing with the channel's 'County Recorder'. Report type ticked '30 Days after withdraw or elimination'; party 'REPUBLICAN'; date 5/12/2014; clerk stamp 'MAY 12 AM 10:28'. ⚠ THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED - neither Yes nor No is ticked. That is an honest BLANK and was NOT read as 'No' (the §A4 precedent). FIVE pages: p1 the 2014 cover (Utah County Code 2-5) / p2 SUMMARY PAGE / p3 SCHEDULE A / p4 SCHEDULE B / p5 a SECOND SCHEDULE B, each classified from its own printed heading. FOLIATION: the filer numbers the four inner sheets '1 of 4' .. '4 of 4', EXCLUDING the cover - the §A4 convention, and the reason no page ordinal was used to locate the summary page. Summary lines 3 and 7 are SLASHED ZEROS (0 under the zero-glyph ruling) and every other summary cell carries a real figure. SOURCE PROPERTY worth carrying: this filer solves the missing Purpose column in TWO ways on one filing - appending the purpose to the payee in the 'Name of Contributor' cell (most rows), and, on four consecutive p4 rows, INVERTING THE FIELDS ENTIRELY: the purpose goes in the payee column and the payee ('BCR Political') in the address column. A parser keyed on column position would emit 'Website use of domain name registration' as a vendor on those rows. He also books most small purchases as REIMBURSEMENTS TO HIMSELF, writing his own name and address alongside the vendor's name, and repeatedly strikes his own name out and rewrites the true payee above the line - handwritten corrections over struck values govern and were followed. PRIVACY: this filing is UNREDACTED; every donor's full street line is legible on p3 and none was carried - city/state only. The two heavy ink strikes on p4 are the FILER's own corrections, not clerk redactions.
